_readme: Flags that are easy to mix up (hand-curated), by ISO 3166 alpha-3 code, with a tip for telling them apart. Shown after you answer a flag card. Flag images still come from Wikidata/Commons; this file only groups them.

groups.tip: Almost identical: Chad's blue is a darker indigo, Romania's a brighter cobalt.
Andorra and Moldova add a coat of arms in the middle; Romania's yellow band is plain.
Same red over white — Monaco's flag is squarer (4:5), Indonesia's longer (2:3).
Poland is the reverse: white on top, red below.
Luxembourg's blue is a light sky blue and its flag is longer; the Netherlands' blue is dark.
Australia: white stars, including a large seven-pointed star under the Union Jack. New Zealand: four red stars.
Ireland has green next to the flagpole; Ivory Coast has orange next to the flagpole.
Mexico has its coat of arms (an eagle on a cactus) in the centre and darker green.
Senegal has a green star in the yellow band; Mali has no star.
Mirror images: Guinea runs red–yellow–green from the pole, Mali green–yellow–red.
Russia is plain. Slovakia's large shield sits toward the pole; Slovenia's small shield (with a mountain) is in the top corner.
Norway is red with a blue cross; Iceland is blue with a red cross.
Colombia's yellow fills the top half; Ecuador adds a coat of arms; Venezuela has equal stripes and an arc of stars.
Liechtenstein has a gold crown in the top corner; Haiti has a coat of arms in a white panel.
Egypt: golden eagle. Iraq: green Arabic script. Syria: two green stars. Yemen: plain.
Qatar is maroon with nine white points; Bahrain is red with five.
Jordan has a small white seven-pointed star in the red triangle; Palestine has none.
Honduras has five blue stars; Nicaragua and El Salvador have their coats of arms in the centre.
Cameroon's star is yellow on the red middle band; Senegal's star is green on yellow.
Ghana has a black star; Bolivia and Lithuania are plain horizontal stripes (red–yellow–green vs yellow–green–red).
Tunisia's crescent and star sit inside a white circle in the middle; Türkiye's are toward the pole.
Singapore adds a white crescent and five stars in the top corner.
